Tate's what's-on page lists four exhibitions running this weekend: Frida: The Making of an Icon (to 3 Jan), Ana Mendieta (to 17 Jan), Light and Magic: The Birth of Art Photography (to 21 Feb) and Julio Le Parc (to 3 May). The page doesn't give ticket prices. Free wandering is still an option if nobody wants to pay.
